title: STRANGE MINUTE · WHAT IF #10

lines.text: What if you didn't sleep for 11 days?
lines.say: What if you didn't sleep for eleven days?

lines.text: In 1964, a 17-year-old named Randy Gardner tried it.
lines.say: In nineteen sixty-four, a seventeen-year-old named Randy Gardner tried it.
Day two: his eyes stopped focusing.

lines.text: Day 4: he saw things that weren't there.
lines.say: Day four: he saw things that weren't there.

lines.text: He thought he was a famous football player.
Day 11: he couldn't count down from 100 by sevens.
lines.say: Day eleven: he couldn't count down from a hundred by sevens.

lines.text: The weird part? On day 10, he beat a sleep scientist at pinball.
lines.say: The weird part? On day ten, he beat a sleep scientist at pinball.

lines.text: After 264 hours awake, he slept about 14 hours.
lines.say: After two hundred sixty-four hours awake, he slept about fourteen hours.

lines.text: Guinness later stopped accepting attempts. Too dangerous.
Decades later, he struggled with insomnia.
So how long have YOU been awake?
